architectureDecisions: D1 — Edit only packages/oracle/src/retrieval-planner.js reserve(). execute() checks stay on reservedBudget. planning-strategies.js stays read-only.

D2 — Drop Math.min(8192, remainingBytes). reserve() takes {items, bytes}, guards reserved.providerCalls>=remaining.maxProviderCalls || reserved.items+items>remaining.maxItems || bytes<1, then accumulates providerCalls/items/materializedBytes and records reservedBudget:{providerCalls:1,items,materializedBytes:bytes}. R_BYTES=remaining.maxMaterializedBytes-reserved.materializedBytes; R_CALLS=remaining.maxProviderCalls-reserved.providerCalls; R_ITEMS=remaining.maxItems-reserved.items; R_EXACT=remaining itemRefs from current itemRef onward. READ_EXACT: items=1, bytes=max(1,floor(R_BYTES/max(1,R_EXACT))). LOOKUP/SEARCH/STRUCTURAL_MAP: items=1, bytes=max(1,floor(R_BYTES/max(1,R_CALLS))). TRAVERSE/FETCH: items=max(1,R_ITEMS), bytes=R_BYTES. Superseded LOOKUP rem/2+SEARCH rem split is revoked.

D3 — Bound worker tests in packages/oracle/test/retrieval-planner.test.js invoke createRetrievalPlanner. RP1: 9000-byte EXACT file, budget 40000, snapshot authority present, execute and facade COMPLETE with reservedBudget.materializedBytes>8192 (covers need 9358). RP2: 9000-byte file under 100 bytes UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED without truncation; LOOKUP_SYMBOL and SEARCH_LEXICAL both reserve when maxItems>=2; failures stay {evidenceId,providerId,reason,detail}. RP3: body calls createRetrievalPlanner({catalog}).plan(REPOSITORY) then asserts workflow.md and context-graph.md omit the 8192-byte cap, no Blackboard ids. RP4: 3/3/20000 plans LOOKUP/SEARCH 1/1 items and 6666/6667 bytes leaving free 1/1/6667 so GRAPH EXPANDs with 2 candidates; 2/2/20000 SKIPs. Bound titles equal negativeCaseBindings; each bound body invokes createRetrievalPlanner.
D4 — Keep execute() catch mapping: reason=ProviderFailure.reason else SOURCE_FAILURE, detail=error.message. No code field.

D5 — CG3 COMPLETE in test/oracle-context-graph-boundary.test.mjs: TRAVERSE takes remaining 4 items and 20000 bytes; assert ['src/a.js','src/c.js'] truncated false. 64-byte budget stays BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (one path ~814 bytes). Rewrite adoption comments to remaining-budget reservation.
D6 — workflow.md and context-graph.md describe remaining-budget reservation with GRAPH headroom, no 8192-byte cap. Replace min(8192, remaining) sentences. No Blackboard ids.

D7 — Evidence: planner-reservation-probe-result.json (9000-byte file reserves 8192/1, facade UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, need 9358) and plan-defect-probe-result.json (delivered 16384 free 3616 EXPANDED; superseded 10000+10000 free 0 SKIPPED; corrected 6666+6667 free 6667 EXPANDED). Both executed on origin/main 8bbbddb6.
D8 — packages/oracle/src/index.js unchanged: createRetrievalPlanner stays the export.
